powers.name: Tempest King
powers.description: After anyone draws Storm Surge, ignore hazards for the next two draws.

powers.name: Merchant
powers.description: Earn 20 gold each time you harbor. Remaining ships sell for 60 gold each.

powers.name: Siren Queen
powers.description: Collect enchanted cards drawn by you and your immediate neighbors. Gain ships for pairs. Ignore hazards during Siren’s Song, when you cannot harbor.

powers.name: Undead Admiral
powers.description: Start with no Plunder tokens; gain one in rounds 6 and 11. Each can claim half the pot when another captain sinks.

powers.name: Mechanic
powers.description: Three repair tokens save ships. Sell repairs for 150 gold. Ignore Broken Rudder.

powers.name: Tide Watcher
powers.description: Take a secret card each round. Wild Wave grants a Tide token outside Calm Waters; each is worth 15 gold at game end.

powers.name: Navigator
powers.description: Five tokens protect you for three draws. While sailing, choose which of the last two cards any Echo copies.

powers.name: Cannoneer
powers.description: Start with no tokens; gain them from Cannon Fire. Spend them to force harboring. Alone, your treasures are doubled.

powers.name: Blood Sailor
powers.description: Earn 40 gold when a starting neighbor sinks. Gain a life the first time each falls to exactly one ship.

powers.name: Storm Warden
powers.description: Start with 7 ships and 3 Warden tokens. Each can save half the pot when you sink; unused tokens are worth 10 gold.

powers.name: Cursed Captain
powers.description: Collect the first two curses each round from anyone. Your own curses never reduce the pot.

powers.name: Parrot Whisperer
powers.description: Start with four tokens. Gain one for every Prophecy drawn. Spare tokens are worth 15 gold.

powers.name: Sea Witch
powers.description: Each Hex gives you 25 gold and takes 10 from every rival. Heart tokens save your ships.

powers.name: Ghost Captain
powers.description: Your only ship is indestructible. Earn 50 gold whenever you sink.

powers.name: Marooned Monarch
powers.description: Ignore Marooned. Earn 100 gold whenever another captain is marooned.

powers.name: Storm Swindler
powers.description: Claim the first treasure outside safe waters each round. It pays you instead of the pot.
